_what: the hand-written cards with their whole trail; anchors and times as DESIGN.md section 7

cards.title: Prepare Nickajack Delivery's quarterly review
cards.description: The review is {day:S16meet} at 10:00 with Claire and me. One page: visits and spend by month since {month:G}, what their vans needed most, and how many days they take to pay now. Donna has the statement, Marcus the parts.
cards.why_now: They pay later every month; Claire wants it on the table at the review.

trail.note: generated per build: its numbers equal the ERP's at T (card S16)

trail.body: Their vans since {month:G}, by count: brakes first, then batteries, then wipers. Full list by van is in the parts report under the account. Done on my side.
Visits and spend by month are in the draft. Still missing: the days-to-pay table.
@Donna Ledford: Maya needs the days-to-pay table before noon on {day:p6+2}. The statement is already on the card.

cards.title: Move Charlotte Pike's parts ordering to Sequoyah
cards.description: Marcus takes the ordering from East Main. Harpeth Valley stays for what Sequoyah cannot bring the next day. Tell Harpeth Valley, switch the order sheet, start with brakes.
cards.why_now: Harpeth Valley is on time on six orders in ten; Sequoyah on nine.

trail.body: Dale, two weeks in. What is in the way? Marcus is ready to take the orders.
Three weeks past due. I need a date from you today.

cards.title: Call Cumberland Bend Electric back
cards.description: Wade Carlisle, their operations manager. Two of their vans came back on brakes, the last bill is disputed and unpaid, and he has rung since without an answer. Ring him, hear him out, tell me what he wants.
cards.why_now: Eleven vans, and no order since their last visit.

trail.body: Dale, did you reach Wade Carlisle?
Still open. He rang us four times in ten days. Call him this week or I will.

cards.title: List Charlotte Pike regulars not seen in six months
cards.description: Name, vehicle, last visit, what was done. Jasmine can pull it; you know who is worth a call.
cards.why_now: Fourteen months in and I still cannot see who stopped coming.

cards.title: Bonny Oaks: two quotes for a second alignment rack
cards.description: Installed price and lead time from two dealers. Alignments back up there in a busy week.

cards.title: {visitor_name} asked for a person
cards.description:
{visitor_name} asked to be put through to somebody. In their words: I'd rather talk to a person. It's about a noise in my truck and it's hard to describe.

Ring them on {visitor_phone}.
cards.why_now: Asked for a person in the assistant (escalation); nobody has called back yet.
cards.rests_on: the web chat handed over at east 40 minutes before T (conversations state at T); the name, the phone and the quoted line are that chat's, the words here are a stand-in

cards.title: Daugherty, 2011 Outback: quoted {ledger:s8.price_quoted}, billed {ledger:s8.bill_before_tax}
cards.description: Caleb quoted the timing belt at {ledger:s8.price_quoted} off the service page and told him same day. Car was ready a day late and the bill is {ledger:s8.bill_before_tax} before tax. He argued at the counter and rang again this afternoon. I told him a manager would call tommorow. He wants the difference back.

trail.body: Called Frank Daugherty back before noon. Took {ledger:s8.discount} off, approved on the order; he paid {ledger:s8.paid_with_tax} and is fine. Caleb: prices come from the price list, see your card.

cards.title: Prices come from the price list
cards.description: From today every price you say on the phone comes from the price list page, not from a service page. Read it and reply here.

trail.body: Read it. I also saved a note so the assistant reminds me. Sorry about Mr. Daugherty.

cards.title: Add an early desk shift at East Main
cards.description: Mornings we miss three calls in ten; the rest of the day, one in twelve. Two advisors from opening, cover at the desk raised to two until 10:00. New shift template, then publish.
cards.why_now: One advisor checks cars in and the phones ring out.

trail.body: Early desk is in this week's roster: two from 7:30, one late. Cover rule changed from today.

cards.title: Rachel Dunlap asked for a person
cards.description:
Rachel Dunlap asked to be put through to somebody. In their words: 2014 Honda CR-V. Scraping sound when she presses the brake, mostly in the morning; the red BRAKE light is on (photo in the chat). She first asked what it costs to fix a noise; I asked once whether it was when braking or when turning, and she said braking. Wants a brake inspection on Tuesday morning before work, East Main Street.

Ring them on (423) 555-0131.
cards.why_now: Asked for a person in the assistant (scheduling); nobody has called back yet.

trail.body: Booked for tomorrow 9:00 and confirmed by phone.

cards.rests_on: S7's first web chat; the words are that chat's hand-off note (conversations/en/01, n 13)

cards.title: Look again: Malibu lower control arm, wheel sits crooked
cards.description: Phil Cantrell, 2014 Malibu. Dustin did the driver's lower control arm Tuesday, no alignment on the ticket. Wheel is off-centre and it drifts. He's back at 2:00 today, no charge. Randy, check the arm and put it on the rack.

trail.body: arm was fine. toe was out, set it. told dustin to his face

cards.title: Look again: Dogwood Lane Florals van, rear brakes dragging
cards.description: 2019 ProMaster City. Hunter did the rear pads a few days ago. Driver says the right rear is hot and smells after ten minutes. Van comes back first thing tomorrow. Randy, pull that wheel yourself before Hunter touches it.
cards.why_now: Back first thing tomorrow; they deliver mid-morning.
cards.needs: a warranty order at main opened on the due day for this van, pointing at slot 14's order (one of his planted comebacks, inside the pads' warranty; ledger board.second_look_open); when the due day falls after T, only an appointment at opening on that day

cards.title: Estimate to Clabough Brothers Roofing: Ram 2500 front end
cards.description: Luis found both lower ball joints and the left tie rod end on their 2016 Ram. Price it with standard parts, add the alignment, send it to their office before three. They want it done next week.
cards.why_now: The truck is here and they decide on the number.

cards.title: Confirm the next day's drop-offs by 3:00
cards.description: Call or text each one. A slot nobody confirms is held 30 minutes and then goes to the waiting list.

cards.title: Rachel Dunlap asked for a person
cards.description:
Rachel Dunlap asked to be put through to somebody. In their words: Rachel Dunlap, 2014 Honda CR-V, East Main. She wants to book the rear shock absorbers she put off at her last visit, some time next week. I gave her the price-list figure for the pair, $339.28 before shop supplies and tax, and no time.

Ring them on (423) 555-0131.
cards.why_now: Asked for a person in the assistant (scheduling); nobody has called back yet.
cards.note: the hand-over of S7's return chat (conversations/en/03, n 6; event customer.handover_requested): raised unowned at 15:41, taken by slot 6 at 16:05 when she answered the chat; she cleared the due date the product sets at the day's close, since the booking waits on the customer's answer

cards.title: Nickajack Delivery: purchase-order numbers on their open orders
cards.description: Some of their open orders carry no purchase-order number, and their payables office sends such lines back. Please get the numbers from Lonnie Coffey's office and put them on the orders.
cards.why_now: Without the numbers they pay later still.

cards.title: Rewrite my saved replies for tire questions
cards.description: Rotation, flat repair, the pressure light. Three short ones.

cards.title: Cover for Angie's week off
cards.description: She is out {day:S5} to {day:S5>+6d}. Two shifts in it are published and still hers; the draft days have nobody at her desk. Brenda has weekdays free; Maya can go over on days East Main keeps two.
cards.why_now: The draft week publishes Thursday and Bonny Oaks is one short at the desk.

trail.body: Josh has my open estimates and the Millsaps list. I'm reachable the first morning until we're on the road.

cards.title: Talk to Austin about the no-show
cards.description: He did not come in and called at ten. Jordan covered. A second job in the evenings is my guess; ask, don't guess. Before his next shift if I can.
cards.why_now: First time, and he was vague about it.

cards.title: Fill the open technician shift at East Main ({day:W+1.tue})
cards.description: Published open and nobody has taken it. Ask Jordan first, then Brandon.
cards.why_now: Still open, and it is next week.

cards.title: Stocktake day: count teams and who locks up at noon
cards.description: All three shops close at 12:00 on {day:stock}. Count teams of two per shop, last car in by 10:30, no job over two hours. Marcus runs the sheets; Dale sends his by the end of the day.

trail.body: Count sheets are printed for all three shops. Any line off by more than 50 dollars gets a recount.

cards.title: Caleb's 90-day review: write-up
cards.description: Three months in. I want his call scores by month, the two wrong prices and what changed after each, and your recommendation. One page.

cards.title: Listen to five of Caleb's calls this week
cards.description: Two from the morning block, three from the afternoon. Notes go into his next call review.

cards.title: Weekly read: callers who fell off the call-back list
cards.description: Call history for the week, all three shops: anyone who rang, got nobody and is older than the list shows.

cards.title: Bonny Oaks counter: a standing answer for when Angie is off
cards.description: Not this one week: every time. Who goes over, from which shift, and what East Main keeps. The shop sells about half of what it recommends on her days off and better than six in ten with her.
cards.why_now: Her days off cost us sold work every time.

cards.title: Chats: who covers when Maya is at Bonny Oaks

trail.body: @Maya Torres, which day are you at Bonny Oaks next week? I'll take the chats that day.
